scope: External-style deterministic fixed-width survey-layout heuristic audit on nine public-grid windows; not a full reproduction of broader CPP systems or a field validation.

scene_manifest.extension_policy: Separate survey-grade public grid extension; not mixed into run_5.
scene_manifest.diagnostic_rebuild_policy: Rebuilt from the crop bounds recorded in the USGS public-grid extension manifest.
